questions.question: How do I reset my account credentials?
questions.answer: Navigate to the portal login page, select 'Forgot Password', enter your registered email address, and follow the one-time authentication link sent within 5 minutes.

questions.question: What are the live support operating hours?
questions.answer: Our technical support team is available Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST). Emergency on-call support is available 24/7 for Enterprise Tier subscribers.

questions.question: What are the standard API request limits?
questions.answer: Standard tier API keys are rate-limited to 60 requests per minute and 10,000 requests per day. Burst allowances allow up to 10 requests per second.
